about: Conformance vectors of the place timeline command.

vectors.name: at the end of the target tracks (the default), picture and sound linked
insert moves everything after the frame on sync-locked tracks
overwrite trims the clip before and cuts into the clip after
a library image comes in as five seconds of picture
a shot without a take gets a placeholder of its planned length and is listed
sound only, on a named track
insert inside a clip splits it; the second parts share a new link
an overwrite that begins or ends inside a transition is refused
two kinds of media named at once
an image has no sound to place
a video of unknown length cannot be placed yet
